# Commands

Every command, generated from `acli-py --help`. Global options go before the command:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `-n`, `--dry-run` | Preview every change instead of making it (also ACLI_PY_DRY_RUN=1). |
| `--account` | Use this saved account (email@site) for one command. |
| `--debug` | Print every HTTP request Jira answers. |
| `-V`, `--version` | Show the version. |
